events.title: The AFP system begins
events.body: Chile replaces its pay-as-you-go pension scheme with individual capitalisation accounts managed by private administrators, a model later studied and copied in other countries.

events.title: First national No + AFP march
events.body: The No + AFP coordinating group holds its first nationwide demonstration, drawing crowds across Chile and putting pension replacement rates onto the national agenda.

events.title: Social outburst begins
events.body: Protests over a metro fare increase broaden into sustained nationwide demonstrations about inequality and the cost of living, with pensions among the central grievances.

events.title: Pension withdrawals allowed
events.body: Congress approves the first law permitting workers to withdraw a portion of their own retirement savings during the pandemic, over government objections.
